sentences.text:
Opposite Party :- State of U.P.
Counsel for Applicant :- Gaurav Kumar Singh Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Ajay Bhanot,J.

By means of the bail application the applicants have prayed to be enlarged on bail in S.T. No.270 of 2023, Case Crime No.71 of 2023 at Police Station-Purandarpur, District-Maharajganj under Sections 498A, 504, 302 IPC.
The applicants are in jail since 07.03.2023.
The bail application of the applicants was rejected by the learned trial court on 26.04.2023.

The following arguments made by Shri Sarfaraz Ahmed, learned counsel holding brief of Shri Gaurav Kumar Singh, learned counsel on behalf of the applicants, which could not be satisfactorily refuted by Shri Paritosh Kumar Malviya, learned AGA-I from the record, entitle the applicant for Vidyavan Sahni And Another vs State Of U.P. on 21 July, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/124139735/
1 grant of bail:
1. The applicants are the brother-in-law and sister-in-law of the deceased.
2.The applicant No.2 is a married lady with six months old child.
3. They reside separately from the deceased and her husband.
4. The applicants never demanded dowry nor did they torture the deceased and they never interfered in the matrimonial life of the deceased and her husband.
5. There is no direct evidence against the applicants.
6. This is a case of circumstantial evidence and the chain of incriminating circumstances against the applicants is not complete.
7. The case of the applicants is distinguishable from that of the husband of the deceased.
8.

entities.text: Vidyavan Sahni And Another vs State Of U.P.
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: The applicants do not have any criminal history apart from this case.
9. The applicants are not flight risk.
The applicants being a law abiding citizen have always cooperated with the investigation and undertake to cooperate with the court proceedings.
There is no possibility of their influencing witnesses, tampering with the evidence or reoffending.
In the light of the preceding discussion and without making any observations on the merits of the case, the bail application is allowed.

Let the applicants-Vidyavan Sahni and Vindhyawasini be released on bail in the aforesaid case crime number, on furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court below.

The following conditions be imposed in the interest of justice:-
(i) The applicants will not tamper with the evidence or influence any witness during the trial.
(ii) The applicants will appear before the trial court on the date fixed, unless personal presence is exempted.

Order Date :- 21.7.2023 Ashish Tripathi  Vidyavan Sahni And Another vs State Of U.P. on 21 July, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/124139735/
